thread:
maya.p: heads up — QA noticed ~3k webinar leads didn't show up in Salesforce after enrichment. HubSpot shows them assigned, SFDC missing.

alina.v: are they getting dropped or deduped? which workflow?

maya.p: workflow id: webinar-handoff-2026-v1. HubSpot status=assigned but SFDC upsert returns 200 with body: {\"result\":\"noop\"} for many.

hubspot-bot: [WARN] webhook retry window for webinar-handoff-2026-v1 > 5s, retries=3 in last_15m

oscar.t: quick peek at connector logs — we're sending batched upserts in 2s windows. SFDC side is acknowledging before async index completes, then a downstream dedupe job silently removes records because external_id not set in time.

zane.h: that dedupe window is the race. when index lag >1s our consumer marks record eligible for dedupe.

alina.v: short-term fix: increase the CRM upsert commit window to 6s for this workflow and set fallback owner to sales-temp-pool, so leads are claimable while we resolve. also disable the dedupe job for this cohort.

oscar.t: agree. plan:
- pause dedupe job for leads where campaign==\"webinar-2026\"
- bump upsert_batch_window_ms 6000 for webinar-handoff-2026-v1
- create alert crm_upsert_noop_rate > 1%
- enqueue backfill job for dropped leads

ops-bot: creating incident ticket: INC-2026-847, assignees: zane.h, oscar.t

oscar.t: applying canary -> update connector config for 5% of traffic, will monitor SFDC create_count and noop_rate.

deploy-bot: connector-config-rollout webinar-handoff-2026-v1 -> 5% canary (tag: crm-racefix-canary)

maya.p: paste sample webhook that returned noop:
```
POST /crm/upsert
{"email":"susan@example.com","external_id":"","lead_id":"L-99821","campaign":"webinar-2026"}
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{"result":"noop","reason":"missing_external_id_at_index_time"}
```

zane.h: long-term: make upsert idempotent using temp_external_id + confirm-on-index callback. also add a short lock (50ms) around index+upsert for high-throughput batches.

alina.v: ok short-term patch live on canary. if metrics look good we'll roll to 100% in 10m. @sales fyi — leads will appear in SFDC shortly after backfill.

oscar.t: metrics after canary 1m:
- sf_create_rate +2.4%
- crm_upsert_noop_rate 0.9% -> 0.2%
- pending_assignments for webinar cohort dropped from 420 -> 95

maya.p: great. schedule backfill run at 4:30pm PST and notify ops-schedule.

alina.v: noted. follow-ups: add CRM SLA doc entry for webinar bursts (target: 99.5% visible in CRM within 10m), and add an automated rollback if noop_rate > 2%.

oscar.t: filing follow-up tickets and a short runbook.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-847 updated: status=monitoring, next_check=5m

zane.h: :thumbsup:
